provenance.basis: The operator supplied run/source association, runtime smoke-tree hash, dirty flag, changelog hash, runtime version and launch limits. notes: A missing log is not_run and has no invented final counts or verdict.
Only a complete matching summary, stage counts, elapsed runtime, SMOKE PASS and successful suite-completion/page-error/vendor guards yields a pass.
Partial checks never count as passed coverage. A missing final result is running while the log has a live smoke process, otherwise incomplete.
Execution limits are configured limits, not inferred causes of a stopped log; any confirmed timeout must retain its incomplete status and exact stopping point.
Zero page-error counts are supported by explicit passing checks, not by an absence of error text; no completed stages gives no asserted aggregate error count.
Running-log hashes describe only bytes read at this refresh and will change as output arrives.
Timing stamps retain raw check lines and elapsed seconds; normalized assertion text excludes only the official timing prefix.
Prior 7019/5034 results stay in their original files with original provenance; this helper neither rewrites nor imports their coverage.
